title: House Robber
statement: Houses stand in a line. Choose houses to collect their values, with no two neighboring houses chosen. Return the greatest total you can collect.

examples.explanation: Taking both ends beats taking the middle.

hints: Conceptual: Consider whether you choose the last house.
Directional: Choosing it rules out its immediate predecessor.
Implementation: Keep the best totals for the two previous prefixes. Compare skipping this house with adding its value to the shorter prefix.
complexityAnalysis: O(n) time and O(1) extra space.
